description: Use this when the user wants to record an expense or cost associated with the currently running task, such as travel, materials, or client entertainment.

amount.description: Expense amount as a decimal string in the user's default currency (e.g. "12.50"). The API stores amounts as BigDecimal strings.

dateTime.description: Optional timestamp for when the expense occurred in ISO 8601 format. If not provided, uses current time.

description.description: Description of what the expense was for (e.g., "Taxi to client site", "Lunch meeting", "Materials")

refunded.description: Whether the expense has already been refunded (paid back to the user)

name: task_add_expense

success.description: Whether the expense was added successfully

title: Add Expense to Task
